verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs offer a dedicated webhooks guide: webhooks "push notifications to your specified endpoint whenever an event happens" in place of polling. llms.txt calls webhooks "the canonical surface for any event-driven workflow," with examples such as large transactions, bill approvals, card issuance and status changes. missing for 10: documentation of how subscriptions are created and managed (an API or UI for registration), a full event-type catalog, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
